items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: he created the band and he kept it going... he called on me to kind of help out with some bookings

ctx.x: A pig foot and a bottle of beer! Okay. You know it’s all true, what you said. It is true. She had all of it. Yeah. The church, the pig foot, and the bottle of beer, she had it all. And she could bring it man. She could simply bring it. And she was a sweetheart. I really loved her. And when it was time for her to sing man, I’d lay back and just listen you know, and it inspired notes for me to play underneath her too, you know, the way she did it, it fit that tenor sound. Yeah. And that was wonderful. We did some…
Yeah I give Dr. Vollmer a lot of credit for the audaciousness of sort of what he does in handling the logistics and all of that. There’s a lot of passion there.

Well Doc, you know Doc was part of the show as well because Doc made a point of informing the audience of the history and the importance of the development of the band and this sound and this music. You know? He made — his opening remarks were very powerful and very much needed. And the way he pulled people together, and the way he cared about people. Doc cares about people. You know? Doc would make sure cats had — he would make sure there were gigs because he said these musicians who made all this great music,…
